problem_statement: The Dns::ResourceRecord class lacks a DecompressRecordData() method needed to decompress record data for DNS record types that may contain compressed DNS names (NS, CNAME, SOA, PTR, MX, RP, AFSDB, RT, PX, SRV, KX, DNAME, NSEC). The method should accept a message, a record offset, and an OwnedPtr<Message> output, and either return kErrorNone with a populated message containing the decompressed data (for record types that require decompression) or leave the output null (for types that do not require decompression). Tests exercise this method for PTR, SRV, TXT (null output), AAAA (null output), and NSEC records, verifying the decompressed output content matches the expected fully-expanded names and data.
